inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Visualize Entra Password Spray Attack with ADX Interactive Map

properties.description:
This rule detects password spray attacks in Entra ID by looking for failed login attempts with specific result codes:

50053 → Account locked due to too many failed sign-in attempts

50126 → Invalid username or password

It then aggregates failed attempts into 30-minute time bins for trend analysis and can be extended with geolocation (country/city/lat/long) to build an interactive attack map.
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Visualize Entra Password Spray Attack with ADX Interactive Map
properties.query:
let SuccesfulSigninIPs = SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ResultType == 0
| where IsInteractive == true
| where ConditionalAccessStatus == "success"
| where DeviceDetail.isManaged == true and DeviceDetail.trustType == "Azure AD joined"
| distinct IPAddress;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ResultType == "50053" or ResultType == "50126"
| where IPAddress !in (SuccesfulSigninIPs)
| summarize PasswordSpray_Per_HalfHour=count() by UserPrincipalName,IPAddress, AppDisplayName, bin (TimeGenerated, 30m)
| where PasswordSpray_Per_HalfHour > 50
